pr_title: changefeedccl: reduce direct access to changefeeddetails
pr_body:
Directly referencing fields on the jobs proto makes
inter-version compatibility harder.
This PR takes a first step toward making most methods use
changefeedbase objects instead.

Fixes #82342.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/83153)

issue_context.title: changefeedccl: Add marker type for "target specification"
issue_context.body:
Recent bugs surrounding mis-use of changefeed target specification showed the need to 
avoid direct access to the underlying changefeed spec descriptor.
In particular AllTargets should return a different type from ChangefeeedTargetSpecification
so that we can be sure that necessary transformations are applied to the target spec before it
can be used.

We should also audit other *direct* uses of "details" proto.  Perhaps consider adding
an another type for "details" altogether.  E.g. "validation" methods could return ValidatedDetails
or some such.

Jira issue: CRDB-16300

review_comments: Do we imagine having methods on `Targets`? If not, perhaps we should use `[]Target` at the call sites?

a bit sad that we have to alloc new array every time...
Do you think we can/should special case when we have nil components?

lint would probably complain about lack of comments on exported symbols.
(even if it won't, we probably should have those).
